tool_schemas.name: read_webpage
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the given URL via Jina AI and returns extracted readable content for the page while recording the invocation and its inputs/outputs under your tenant. If an idempotency_key is provided, repeated submissions with the same key return the original result rather than creating a new request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or not tied to a tenant, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the tenant has no remaining quota, NOT_FOUND if the URL cannot be retrieved, and CONFLICT if the idempotency_key was previously used with different parameters.

url.description: The webpage URL to fetch and extract readable content from.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to deduplicate repeated identical requests.

tool_schemas.name: search_web
tool_schemas.description: Runs the provided query through Jina AI web search and returns a list of results up to limit (if provided), recording the invocation and its inputs/outputs under your tenant; this endpoint returns a single page of results and does not provide pagination tokens. If an idempotency_key is provided, repeated submissions with the same key return the original result rather than creating a new request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty or limit is not a valid integer, UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or not tied to a tenant, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the tenant has no remaining quota, and CONFLICT if the idempotency_key was previously used with different parameters.

query.description: The search query to run against Jina AI's web search.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to deduplicate repeated identical requests.

tool_schemas.name: fact_check
tool_schemas.description: Checks the provided statement using Jina AI’s grounding engine and returns an evidence-grounded assessment, recording the invocation and its inputs/outputs under your tenant. If an idempotency_key is provided, repeated submissions with the same key return the original result rather than creating a new request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if statement is missing/empty, UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or not tied to a tenant, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the tenant has no remaining quota, and CONFLICT if the idempotency_key was previously used with different parameters.

statement.description: The claim/statement to fact-check using grounding evidence.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to deduplicate repeated identical requests.

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded tool invocations for the authenticated workspace, newest first. Supports filtering by tool_name and status. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the key is not entitled to read logs.

created_after.description: Return only requests created after this timestamp (inclusive).

created_before.description: Return only requests created before this timestamp (inclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_tool_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tool request by id for the authenticated workspace, including its stored input/output/error and upstream metadata. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist in your workspace, and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_tool_request
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-flight tool request by id for the authenticated workspace by transitioning its status to cancelled. Only requests in queued or running may be cancelled; otherwise the call is refused with CONFLICT. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist in your workspace, and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

id.description: The tool request id to cancel.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason to record.

tool_schemas.name: list_web_artifacts
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted web artifacts (webpages, search results, or fact-check evidence) for the authenticated workspace. Supports filtering by tool_request_id and artifact_type. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

tool_request_id.description: Filter artifacts belonging to a specific tool request id.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: create_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key under the authenticated workspace and returns the plaintext key exactly once along with the created key metadata. The key is active by default. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if the caller is not entitled to manage keys, and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

name.description: Human-friendly name for the API key.

metadata.name: Jina AI
metadata.description: This backend powers a thin API gateway over Jina AI capabilities for web reading, web search, and grounding-based fact checking. It stores tenants and API keys, logs each tool invocation as a request with inputs/outputs, and enforces per-tenant quotas plus lifecycle/status transitions for async/fail
